training_evidence: Read-only original-training audit: at o70/o80/o90 all query clocks have five non-self neighbors; neighbor-minus-own wind/power correlates with next1/2h own power change by 0.10-0.20. Descriptive motivation only, not estimated forecast gain. Hourly power_setpoint has no finite training observations; do not fabricate it.
data: Original raw labels, scaler, six units, hourly input72/h2/stride3 and exact outer cohort unchanged. Add only non-self contemporaneous or historical wind/power summaries; no future NWP, clipping, imputation of original records or dropped evaluation windows.

spatial_features.missing_neighbors: difference0/std0/fraction0 when none; partially missing channels use finite neighbors only
spatial_features.availability: All used hourly end-stamps <= own last observed hour; assumes farm observations delivered without extra latency

target: For each lead regress (raw_future_power-raw_last_observed_power)/original_target_std. Add predicted correction to exact raw observed anchor; no output clipping. Ridge extra scaler fits on that origin fit only; HGB uses fixed original standardized input coordinates.
selection: Same v12 three expanding training origins. Fixed configurations, no searched epoch. Both MAE and RMSE non-worse than Persistence at EACH origin, tolerance1e-8 only; minimize mean of three mean MAE/RMSE ratios, require ratio<1-1e-8. Tie fixed capacity proxy then name. No eligible model=>exact Persistence. No per-origin stitching or outer-guided selection.
outer_refit: Only chosen configuration once on complete original outer-train. No outer selection, runner-up evaluation or retry. Historical outer fold is development evidence, not independent confirmation.
budget: Reuse three completed own Ridge alpha100 origin fits after full artifact/code/window/hash checks. New three FarmRidge fits and six fixed200iteration HGB fits (two lead heads per fit), plus at most one selected full refit. No additional candidates, seeds, or hyperparameter retries.
primary_success: Both outer MAE and RMSE improve vs Persistence and frozen original numerical base. Spatial contribution additionally requires farm-minus-own training comparisons; a selected own-HGB gain is NOT spatial or Wiki evidence.
resource_policy: CPU sklearn trial, no CUDA initialization required; own BLAS/OpenMP limited to2threads. Never signal, throttle or reconfigure another user's process. No duplicate numerical suite.
limitations: Repeatedly inspected training/outer development periods, conservative finite selection, small one-fold pilot. New neighbor information budget differs from historical single-turbine baselines; do not call them tuned/matched SOTA. Assumed immediate farm telemetry may fail in deployment. Descriptive correlation does not establish predictive value.
